title: Stored cross-site scripting in the ticket view
description: The ticket subject is rendered without escaping, so markup submitted by one user runs in the browser of any agent opening the ticket.
reproduction: 1. Open https://support.example.com/tickets/new 2. Enter as the subject 3. Submit, then open the ticket as an agent.
impact: Any agent viewing the ticket runs attacker-controlled script in the context of the support tool, which can read the session cookie.
expected_behaviour: The subject is displayed as text.
actual_behaviour: The subject is parsed as HTML.
